items.title: 100% Full IP & Code Ownership

items.title: Senior Architects Only
items.desc: No junior developers, no interns, no offshore bench. The senior architects who scope your technical roadmap are the ones who write and review every pull request.

items.title: Milestone-Driven Sprints
items.desc: Every sprint has clear, binary acceptance criteria deployed to a live staging environment. If a milestone does not meet the agreed criteria, you do not approve payment.

items.title: Zero Technical Debt
